verdict.rationale: Casium publishes dedicated EB-1A and EB-2 NIW guides that cover self-petitioning via I-140 without an employer sponsor or labor certification. A blog post treats O-1, EB-1 and EB-2 NIW petitions together under shared foundations, and the individual offering promises to lay out 'the pathway ahead.' That suggests the O-1 is framed as a step toward a green card, but no evidence explicitly documents a sequenced O-1-to-green-card strategy. Missing for 10: an explicit O-1-to-EB-1A/NIW transition or strategy guide, evidence that this continuation planning is part of the founder engagement or pricing, and independent corroboration that clients receive this roadmap.
